description: {{webshop::::Coming soon: }}Give your trade customers their own online glass ordering portal. Branded webshop, Stripe and PayPal payments, custom Georgian bars and cutouts — all built into Coglass.
lead: Let trade customers browse and reorder from a branded webshop on their own agreed prices, and pay by card — orders drop straight into Coglass. New revenue while you sleep.
steps_h2: From customer order to job in Coglass — automatically
steps_sub: The webshop handles the order, the payment and the confirmation. Your team just sees a new order waiting to be processed.
inc_h2: {{webshop::A complete glass ordering portal — ready to launch::A complete glass ordering portal — coming soon}}
inc_sub: {{webshop::Included on every plan — no add-on, no extra fee. No web developer needed: configure your webshop in Coglass settings and start taking orders the same day.::Coming soon, and included in your plan when it launches — no add-on, no extra fee. No web developer needed: you will set it up in Coglass settings.}}
steps: Your trade customers visit your branded glass shop — either at its own URL or embedded directly on your existing website via a copy-paste iframe. They browse your enabled products by category.

For each product, they enter dimensions in millimetres and configure options — Georgian bars (positions, colour, width), lead design (diamond or square, cell size, colour), cutouts (circles, rectangles, letterboxes, notches) with live price updating.

Customers enter their details and choose how to pay: submit as an enquiry, pay by card via Stripe, or pay via PayPal. Trade customers who are logged in automatically get their trade discount applied at checkout.

The moment the order is placed, it appears in your Coglass admin panel as a webshop enquiry — with full customer details, all glass specifications, dimensions and payment status. No re-entering data, no calls to take the order.

Review the enquiry and convert it to a full Coglass order with one click. All glass lines, dimensions and operations carry across — the job goes straight into production planning and supplier ordering.

Logged-in customers can view their order history and status in the customer portal — new, awaiting payment, paid, converted. Confirmation emails are sent automatically when orders are placed and updated.
included: Branded storefront
Your company name, logo and accent colour. Customers see your brand, not Coglass.
Glass configurator
Customers enter dimensions and add Georgian bars, lead designs and cutouts with a live visual preview and price update.
Embeddable on your website
Copy-paste one iframe snippet and the shop runs inside your existing website.
Card payments
Take card payments online through Stripe, paid into your own Stripe account.
PayPal checkout
Accept PayPal payments as an alternative — many trade customers prefer it for business purchases.
Enquiry-only option
Prefer to quote manually? Enable enquiry mode — customers submit the order without paying, you quote from Coglass.
Trade discount pricing
Logged-in trade customers see their own price list — the same one their quotes use — with the price updating as they type their sizes.
Delivery fee configuration
Set a base delivery fee, free delivery threshold, and postcode-based regional surcharges — all configured in settings.
Customer order history
Trade customers log in to view their past orders, status and delivery details — reduces calls chasing order updates.
Auto-convert to order
Configure Coglass to automatically convert paid webshop orders to live jobs — zero manual steps for repeat trade orders.
Confirmation emails
Customers receive automatic order confirmation emails when they place an order — professional and immediate.
Guest checkout
Customers can place orders without creating an account — lower friction for one-off or retail orders.
